Years later, I was engaged in a minimum wage job, [43] to support my young family. One day, I [44] myself with 10 dollars remaining until the next payday. The petrol tank of my shabby car was also empty, so I [45] at a convenience store and filled the tank with 5 dollars' worth of petrol. While I was about to [46] to pay, I noticed the female in front of me desperately [47] in her purse to find sufficient [48] to pay for 2 gallons of dairy products. For an instant, [49] held back my heart, but then I stepped forward and laid down my last 5 dollars to assist her in getting the [50]. As I left the [51], I was completely penniless, but my heart felt [52] and still seemed like the [53] man in the world. It didn't make sense in terms of mathematics. Maybe I didn't need to understand it but just enjoy it.

Life and love are much like algebra. They can be a [54] that we never fully comprehend. The truth is that the more we share love, the more it [55] within us.

questions.explanation: 作者提到自己本来擅长数学，但一上高中学代数，突然觉得一切都变得“抽象”了。因为代数包含字母和符号，比基础算术更抽象，这解释了为什么作者觉得难以理解。选项D符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(extraordinary)：语境句：She has an extraordinary memory and can remember everyone's name. 固定搭配：extraordinary ability, extraordinary achievement
B(absurd)：语境句：It is absurd to believe that the earth is flat. 固定搭配：absurd idea, entirely absurd
C(easy)：语境句：The exam was so easy that I finished it in half an hour. 固定搭配：easy to do, take it easy
D(abstract)：语境句：Algebra involves abstract concepts that can be hard to grasp. 固定搭配：abstract art, abstract concept

questions.explanation: 句意：学代数就像把我的头往墙上撞。这里考察英语固定习语“knock/bang one's head against a (brick) wall”，表示白费力气、做徒劳无功且令人沮丧的事。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(head)：语境句：Trying to convince him is like knocking your head against the wall. 固定搭配：knock one's head, keep one's head
B(leg)：语境句：He broke his leg while skiing in the mountains. 固定搭配：pull one's leg, break a leg
C(back)：语境句：He carried the heavy box on his back. 固定搭配：turn one's back on, back to back
D(feet)：语境句：After the long hike, my feet were completely sore. 固定搭配：stand on one's own feet, get cold feet

questions.explanation: 前文提到从事“minimum wage job（最低工资的工作）”，后文提到要“support my young family（养活年轻的家庭）”，因此作者在经济上是“挣扎的，艰难维持的”。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(determining)：语境句：He is determining the best way to solve the issue. 固定搭配：determine to do, determining factor
B(struggling)：语境句：The single mother is struggling to support her three children. 固定搭配：struggle to do sth, struggle for survival
C(preparing)：语境句：The students are preparing for their final exams. 固定搭配：prepare for, be prepared to do
D(promising)：语境句：She is a promising young artist with a bright future. 固定搭配：promising future, highly promising

questions.explanation: 固定句型 find oneself + 介词短语/分词，表示“发觉自己处于某种境地”。这里指作者发觉自己离下次发薪日只剩10美元了。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(found)：语境句：I woke up and found myself in a completely unfamiliar room. 固定搭配：find oneself doing sth, find out
B(made)：语境句：His hard work made him a successful entrepreneur. 固定搭配：make a difference, make sense
C(earned)：语境句：She earned a lot of respect through her dedication. 固定搭配：earn money, earn a living
D(presented)：语境句：He presented his passport to the customs officer. 固定搭配：present sth to sb, present itself

questions.explanation: 作者油箱空了，所以在一个便利店“停车”。pull up 意为“（车辆）停下，停车”，符合语境。pull out意为“驶出”；pull off意为“成功完成，靠边停车”；pull down意为“拆毁”。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(pulled out)：语境句：The train slowly pulled out of the station. 固定搭配：pull out of, pull out a tooth
B(pulled off)：语境句：Despite the difficulties, she managed to pull off the project. 固定搭配：pull off a deal, pull off the road
C(pulled up)：语境句：A black car pulled up in front of the hotel. 固定搭配：pull up at, pull up a chair
D(pulled down)：语境句：The old building was pulled down to make way for a new mall. 固定搭配：pull down a building, pull sb down

questions.explanation: 句意：当我要“排队”付钱时。根据常识，在便利店付款需要排队。queue意为“排队等候”。虽然选项A、B、C有停留之意，但排队付款最符合便利店的场景。选D。
questions.supplement:
A(stop)：语境句：We had to stop working because of the power cut. 固定搭配：stop doing sth, stop by
B(stay)：语境句：He decided to stay at home rather than go out. 固定搭配：stay up, stay away from
C(get)：语境句：You need to get permission before using the equipment. 固定搭配：get used to, get over
D(queue)：语境句：We had to queue for hours to buy the concert tickets. 固定搭配：queue up, jump the queue

questions.explanation: 句意：前面的女士拼命地在钱包里翻找。go in/into one's purse 或者 go through one's purse 表示“在钱包里翻找”。seek虽然有寻找之意，但是及物动词（seek sth），不接 in。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(filling)：语境句：She was filling the bottle with fresh water. 固定搭配：fill with, fill out
B(going)：语境句：She is going through her bag to find her keys. 固定搭配：go through, go in
C(seeking)：语境句：They are seeking help from the local government. 固定搭配：seek to do, hide and seek
D(breaking)：语境句：He is breaking the rules by leaving early. 固定搭配：break down, break into

questions.explanation: 女士在钱包里找足够的“现金”来付款买奶制品。钱包(purse)里通常装的是现金(cash)。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(cash)：语境句：I don't have any cash on me, can I pay by card? 固定搭配：pay in cash, short of cash
B(offers)：语境句：The company received several job offers from candidates. 固定搭配：special offer, make an offer
C(credit)：语境句：You can buy the goods on credit and pay later. 固定搭配：credit card, on credit
D(lists)：语境句：She made a shopping list before going to the supermarket. 固定搭配：on the list, shopping list

questions.explanation: 句意：有一瞬间，“自私”阻挡了我的心。因为作者自己也只剩5美元了，所以一开始犹豫不想帮忙，这是人性的“自私(selfishness)”。但随后作者克服了这一点，上前帮忙。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(generosity)：语境句：His generosity to the poor is well known in the town. 固定搭配：show generosity, act of generosity
B(selfishness)：语境句：Her selfishness caused her to lose many good friends. 固定搭配：out of selfishness, extreme selfishness
C(selflessness)：语境句：The hero's selflessness saved many lives during the fire. 固定搭配：act of selflessness, demonstrate selflessness
D(kindness)：语境句：A little act of kindness can brighten someone's day. 固定搭配：do sb a kindness, out of kindness

questions.explanation: 前文提到这位女士在找钱支付“2 gallons of dairy products（2加仑的奶制品）”，所以作者帮忙买下的就是“牛奶(milk)”。选D。
questions.supplement:
A(gas)：语境句：I need to stop at the station to get some gas. 固定搭配：gas station, run out of gas
B(money)：语境句：He saves a lot of money by cooking at home. 固定搭配：make money, spend money on
C(car)：语境句：She drives a small car to work every day. 固定搭配：by car, rent a car
D(milk)：语境句：Drinking a glass of milk before bed helps you sleep. 固定搭配：fresh milk, spill the milk

questions.explanation: 根据第45题可知，作者是在一家“convenience store（便利店）”里发生的这一切，所以这里是“当我离开这家商店(store)时”。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(woman)：语境句：The woman standing by the window is my teacher. 固定搭配：young woman, pregnant woman
B(line)：语境句：Please stand behind the yellow line. 固定搭配：in line, cross the line
C(store)：语境句：I went to the store to buy some daily necessities. 固定搭配：department store, convenience store
D(home)：语境句：It's getting late, and I want to go home now. 固定搭配：at home, feel at home

questions.explanation: 作者虽然把最后的钱给了别人导致“penniless（身无分文）”，但是内心充满了爱与帮助他人的喜悦，所以心是“充实的(full)”。与空空如也的口袋/油箱形成对比。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(full)：语境句：Though his wallet was empty, his heart was full of joy. 固定搭配：full of, to the full
B(empty)：语境句：The room was completely empty when we arrived. 固定搭配：empty promise, empty-handed
C(broken)：语境句：He tried to fix the broken chair with glue. 固定搭配：broken heart, broken English
D(surprised)：语境句：She was surprised to see her old friend at the party. 固定搭配：be surprised at, pleasantly surprised

questions.explanation: 前文说作者“completely penniless（身无分文）”，此处产生强烈的对比：“却感觉自己像是世界上最富有(wealthiest)的人”。wealthiest 相比 happiest 更好地呼应了 penniless 这个与金钱相关的词。选D。
questions.supplement:
A(happiest)：语境句：Winning the competition made him the happiest boy alive. 固定搭配：happiest moment, happiest memories
B(poorest)：语境句：He grew up in one of the poorest neighborhoods in the city. 固定搭配：poorest countries, the poorest of the poor
C(smartest)：语境句：She is considered the smartest student in her class. 固定搭配：smartest decision, smartest move
D(wealthiest)：语境句：He is known as one of the wealthiest men in the world. 固定搭配：wealthiest families, wealthiest nations

questions.explanation: 句意：生活和爱就像代数，它们可能是一个我们永远无法完全理解的“谜(mystery)”。后文强调爱越分享越多，不符合常理，所以是一种谜团。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(course)：语境句：I registered for an online course to improve my English. 固定搭配：of course, in the course of
B(mystery)：语境句：How the pyramids were built remains a mystery. 固定搭配：solve a mystery, remain a mystery
C(problem)：语境句：We need to find a solution to this urgent problem. 固定搭配：solve a problem, no problem
D(skill)：语境句：Communication is an essential skill in the workplace. 固定搭配：practical skill, communication skill

questions.explanation: 句意：事实是，我们分享的爱越多，它在我们内心就越“膨胀/增加(expands)”。这不符合数学减法规律，但符合爱的规律。expands意为扩大、增加，符合语境。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(sees)：语境句：He sees a bright future for the company. 固定搭配：see to it that, see off
B(takes)：语境句：It takes time and effort to master a new language. 固定搭配：take place, take apart
C(expands)：语境句：Water expands when it freezes into ice. 固定搭配：expand on, expand one's horizons
D(exchanges)：语境句：The two teams exchanged gifts before the match started. 固定搭配：exchange ideas, in exchange for

section_2_word_form.passage:
Lion dance roars with shared values

The powerful people-to-people bonds between China and Malaysia take many expressions considering the range of shared traditional and [56] values between the two nations. The Malay people have taken great interest in the lion dance, a tradition [57] emerged over a thousand years ago in China and has many admirers in modern Malaysia.

Among them [58] Adzwin Puteri Faizal, a petite young woman, who is part of the locally renowned Yong Jun Lion Dance Association. "In earlier generations, it was difficult for people from other ethnic groups and women [59] lion dance, but things have changed. The [60] and inclusiveness of lion dance have allowed us to build a family here," her lion dance master said. The lion dance in Malaysia shares its roots with the Chinese lion dance, [61] from the southern lion dance style. It arrived in Malaysia with Chinese immigrants and took root. Initially, the lion dance [62] during Chinese festivals and celebrations, but [63] the blending of Malaysia's ethnicities (种族特点) and cultures, it gradually crossed ethnic and religious boundaries, [64] a beloved cultural activity for all communities. Its cultural value is widely recognized by the public.

2024 marks the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Malaysia. Both sides celebrated the lion dance as [65] form of shared history, and jointly promoted and safeguarded the heritage.

questions.explanation: 空前有并列连词and，前面是形容词traditional，空后是名词values，因此这里需要填culture的形容词形式cultural，作定语修饰values。意为“文化价值观”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(cultural)：语境句：The festival is an important cultural event for the local people. 固定搭配：cultural diversity, cultural heritage。原词culture其它变形：culture (n. 文化), culturally (adv. 文化上地)。

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，emerged over a thousand years ago... 是一个定语从句，修饰先行词a tradition。从句中缺少主语，先行词是物，因此填关系代词that或which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that/which)：语境句：This is the book that/which changed my perspective on life. 固定搭配：in which, all that。

questions.explanation: 这里是倒装句 Among them is Adzwin...。主语是后置的 Adzwin Puteri Faizal，属于第三人称单数。全文描述的是客观事实和现状，时态用一般现在时，故填is。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is)：语境句：Among the students is a boy from Africa. 固定搭配：there is, is doing。原词be其它变形：are, was, were, been, being。

questions.explanation: 考察固定句型：It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.，此处表示“对其他族群的人和女性来说，学习舞狮曾是困难的”，故填动词不定式to learn作真正的主语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to learn)：语境句：It is essential for us to learn a foreign language. 固定搭配：learn to do, learn from。原词learn其它变形：learning (n./v-ing), learned (adj. 博学的 / v-ed)。

questions.explanation: 定冠词The之后需要名词，且与and后面的名词inclusiveness（包容性）并列。unique的名词形式是uniqueness，意为“独特性”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(uniqueness)：语境句：The uniqueness of this artwork makes it highly valuable. 固定搭配：appreciate the uniqueness, cultural uniqueness。原词unique其它变形：uniquely (adv. 独特地)。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰后面的介词短语 from the southern lion dance style（源自南狮风格），需要用副词形式。specific的副词是specifically，意为“具体地、明确地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(specifically)：语境句：These tools were designed specifically for beginners. 固定搭配：specifically designed, more specifically。原词specific其它变形：specific (adj. 具体的), specifics (n. 细节)。

questions.explanation: 句子的主语是the lion dance，与perform之间是被动关系，且由时间状语Initially（最初）可知，表示过去发生的事情，应使用一般过去时的被动语态，故填was performed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was performed)：语境句：The surgery was successfully performed by an expert. 固定搭配：perform a task, perform well。原词perform其它变形：performance (n. 表演), performer (n. 表演者), performing (adj. 表演的)。

questions.explanation: 句意：但是“随着”马来西亚种族和文化的融合，它逐渐跨越了界限。这里考查伴随状语或原因状语，用介词with表示“随着……”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：With the development of technology, life has become much easier. 固定搭配：with the help of, come up with。

questions.explanation: 前文“it gradually crossed ethnic and religious boundaries”是一个完整的句子。逗号后用非谓语动词作结果状语，表示自然而然的结果，主动语态，故填现在分词becoming。
questions.supplement: 正确形(becoming)：语境句：The company expanded rapidly, becoming the largest in the country. 固定搭配：become of, become accustomed to。原词become其它变形：became (v-ed), becomes (单三)。

questions.explanation: form此处为可数名词单数，表示“一种形式”，泛指概念，且form的发音以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：Dancing is a great form of exercise. 固定搭配：a form of, in the form of。
